title: GoogleADKHackathon
summary: A Google Agent Development Kit hackathon project implementing a multi-modal synthetic data agent with a tool for generating synthetic tabular data. The tabular tool imports SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and download_demo to fit and sample mock data on demand as an agent skill.
evidence: MultiModalSyntheticAgent.ipynb:225 'synthesizer = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(metadata)' called within get_tabular_synthetic_data() tool
needs: Only one notebook cell examined; unclear if other modalities in the 'multi-modal' agent also rely on SDV.
